♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 IPHUMILE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, i-AutoCaptions ene-**Your script** ne-**Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, kunye ne-**Flex Studio (Beta)** ekhuphela kuqala ize ikubuze phambi kokuba ifakwe.

*(Yifake phezu kwenguqulelo yakho yangoku uze uqalise kwakhona i-After Effects kanye.)*

♦️ **Okutsha: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Uyilo lwe-**Map desk**, ukukhangela iindawo ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route nokunye), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, izimbo zeemaphu zasimahla kunye ne-**Open in Flex Maps**.
* Izixhobo zayo ezongezelelweyo (ukuvumelanisa ngoko nangoko, izimbo, iilebhile, 3D, Finalize) ngoku ziyalayisha ngokwenene ngaphakathi kwi-After Effects.

♦️ **Okutsha kwi-AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (efini, isebenzisa iikhredithi ze-Flex AI) yinjini ecetyiswayo, kwaye ikhethwe kanye kubo bonke. Khetha i-Whisper kwakhona ukuze wenze imibhalo engezantsi simahla kwikhompyutha yakho (i-Translate To ifuna i-Whisper). Xa iseva ixakekile, ikubonisa indawo yakho emgceni.
* **Your script**: imibhalo engezantsi ithatha upelo namagama e-script yakho naphi na apho uwathethe khona loo magama.
* Isiphumo se-**Editable template**: imibhalo engezantsi njengeeleya zetemplate onokutshintsha isimbo sazo kwi-Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Akukho nto ikhethiweyo kwaye i-Source media ayinanto? Ikunika **yonke i-composition**. Isandi esifanayo siphinda sisebenzise i-transcript yaso.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ikhuphela kuqala, emva koko ibuze **Install / Not now**.
* I-app (2.0.0-beta.2): iindawo zokusebenza ze-**PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, amaqhosha ezixhobo afana nawe-After Effects, iiklip zivuleka ngoko nangoko, kwaye i-OPEN isebenza kwii-precomp nakwii-adjustment layer.

♦️ **Okulungisiweyo**
* Iziphumo zethim ebezingekho kwii-PC ezininzi ze-Windows zibuyile (zilula ngakumbi xa iziphumo zopopayi ze-Windows zicinyiwe).

♦️ **Indawo ngokuzikhethela, yokukhusela ilayisensi**
* Kubuzwa kanye kuphela, kwaye kungokuzikhethela: nokuba ukhetha **No thanks** yonke into iyaqhubeka isebenza. Ungayitshintsha kwi-**Flex Settings > Privacy**. Igcinwa iinyanga ezili-12, ayize ithengiswe, kwaye ayize yabelwane nangubani ngaphandle kwalapho umthetho ufuna khona.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 IPHUMILE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack ingena kwi-AutoCaptions** nezimbo zegama ngalinye, uyilo, intshukumo kunye nezandi. **UN-NEST** kunye nee-blend mode ziyasebenza kwi-Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** kukucofa kanye, kwaye **Flex Studio (Beta)** ivula iklip yakho ngqo ukusuka kwiphaneli.

*(Yifake phezu kwenguqulelo yakho yangoku uze uqalise kwakhona i-Premiere Pro kanye.)*

♦️ **Okutsha: Imibhalo engezantsi eshukumayo kwi-AutoCaptions**
* **Isimbo segama**: nika naliphi na igama imibala yalo, ifonti kunye nokugqitywa kwe-Flat, Shine okanye Glow.
* **Uyilo lwemigca**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside kunye ne-Line.
* **Intshukumo yegama ngalinye** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake nokunye) enombono wangaphambili, kunye nezandi ze-**Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Izimbo zamagama nentshukumo zifuna isiphumo se-**Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (efini, isebenzisa iikhredithi ze-Flex AI) ngoku yinjini ecetyiswayo, kwaye ikhethwe kanye kubo bonke; khetha injini ye-Whisper ukuze wenze imibhalo engezantsi simahla ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.
* **Your script** (imowudi ye-Captions): imibhalo engezantsi ithatha amagama e-script yakho apho uwathethe khona loo magama.
* Xa kungekho nto ikhethiweyo (ikhadi le-Source alinanto) ikunika **yonke i-timeline**; imibhalo engezantsi igcinwa ecaleni kweprojekthi yakho.

♦️ **Okutsha: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** ilandelela iklip kwi-app; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** ibuyisela umkhondo. Ayifakwanga? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** iyayikhuphela, emva koko ibuze **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Okutshintshileyo**
* **AUTO CUT** ihlalutya iklip ekhethiweyo ize isike ngokucofa kanye. **Retakes** ibamba izivakalisi eziqaliswe kwakhona.
* **Audio Studio** ngoku ineethebhu ezincinci ezintandathu. I-**Library** ngoku ikwi-Nest Saver.

♦️ **Okulungisiweyo**
* **UN-NEST** kwi-Premiere 26.5 (ibisala yonke i-nest), kunye nee-blend mode ezifana ne-Screen ebezibuyela kwi-Normal (i-Premiere ngesiNgesi).
* I-chip ebomvu ye-**AUTOSAVE 0:00**, umbono wangaphambili omnyama we-Caption Stack, kunye neziphumo zethim ebezingekho kwii-PC ezininzi ze-Windows.

♦️ **Indawo ngokuzikhethela, yokukhusela ilayisensi**
* Kubuzwa kanye kuphela, kwaye kungokuzikhethela: nokuba ukhetha **No thanks** yonke into iyaqhubeka isebenza. Ungayitshintsha kwi-**Flex Settings > Privacy**. Igcinwa iinyanga ezili-12, ayize ithengiswe, kwaye ayize yabelwane nangubani ngaphandle kwalapho umthetho ufuna khona.
